books.title: Dungeon Crawler Carl
books.blurb: Earth is foreclosed on, and the only humans left standing are the ones who happened to be outside. Carl goes down into the dungeon barefoot, carrying a cat.

books.title: Carl's Doomsday Scenario
books.blurb: The Over City is the first floor that behaves like a place rather than a level — and Carl picks up a bomb he can never put down.

books.title: The Dungeon Anarchist's Cookbook
books.blurb: Every subway on Earth, welded into one knot of moving trains — and a manual left behind by the crawlers of an earlier season.

books.title: The Gate of the Feral Gods
books.blurb: Sealed pocket worlds, a portable gate that opens onto things which should not be given doors, and the discovery that the NPCs are people.

books.title: The Butcher's Masquerade
books.blurb: Wealthy aliens buy licences to hunt crawlers for sport. Carl's answer is to hunt them back, on camera.

books.title: The Eye of the Bedlam Bride
books.blurb: A floor that runs on cards, built out of Earth's own dead, where people become playable pieces — and Mordecai's past stops being backstory.

books.title: This Inevitable Ruin
books.blurb: Nine armies, thirty days, one castle, and no respawns. The floor where the dungeon's props declare independence on live galactic television.

books.title: A Parade of Horribles
books.blurb: A racing floor with a worsening track, a system that has started to glitch, and a coming-out party for the ages.

floors.name: The First Floor
floors.premise: Dirt, corridors and safe rooms beneath the ruins of Earth. The tutorial floor, where the survivors learn the rules and how lethal they are.
floors.recap: Dirt, corridors and safe rooms, and the discovery that the tutorial is lethal. Carl comes down in a leather jacket, heart boxers and his ex-girlfriend's pink Crocs; within the hour he has a Goblin Pass Tattoo and a Trollskin Shirt. Donut eats an Enhanced Pet Biscuit and wakes up talking, takes party leadership on stat points, renames the party after herself, and equips the Crown of the Sepsis Whore without reading the warning — quietly enrolling herself in a royal succession eight floors below. Mordecai, an indentured Borant guide who was once a crawler himself, starts teaching them the rules production would rather they learned too late to use.

floors.name: The Second Floor
floors.premise: Open ground, spawn limits and the first real bosses. The floor where the party takes its final shape and the audience starts paying attention.
floors.recap: Where the party takes its final shape. Carl and Donut find Mongo — a level-1 pet-class mob, seven inches of pink downy feathers — locked in a cage in a secret pet reward room, and Donut wins him over by teaching him to open Brindle Grubs. From this floor the Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph leaves Carl's bare feet permanently shiny, which the audience adores. The thesis of the first book lands here: the dungeon rewards spectacle and punishes decency, unless you can make decency spectacular.

floors.name: The Over City
floors.premise: The Over City: a colossal ruin built on top of itself, cut into themed districts and run by NPC factions. The first floor that behaves like a place rather than a level.
floors.recap: A colossal ruin built on top of itself, cut into themed districts and run by NPC factions. Class selection happens here: Carl takes Primal and the unique Compensated Anarchist, Donut takes Cat and Former Child Actor, and on Odette's advice they manoeuvre Mordecai into becoming Donut's manager — an appointment that had to look like an accident. Katia, ten levels behind and abandoned by Eva, is taken into the Royal Court. The Desperado Club opens. During the Fools Who Broke the Glass Quest, Carl builds Carl's Doomsday Scenario by wrapping a Sheol Glass Reaper Case around an exploding Soul Crystal — a 45-kilometre blast he can never put down. The floor ends with Borant spending its one annual veto rather than pay out 83 Celestial boxes.

floors.name: The Iron Tangle
floors.premise: The Iron Tangle — every subway system on Earth welded into one impossible knot of moving trains. A puzzle the size of a continent, and the trains do not stop.
floors.recap: Every subway system on Earth welded into one impossible knot of moving trains — a puzzle the size of a continent, and the trains do not stop. Carl becomes the twenty-fifth holder of The Dungeon Anarchist's Cookbook and learns that Earth is not the first season and that resistance to the show has a written tradition. Maggie My returns as a Scree parasite riding another crawler; Frank dies of it, and Mongo finishes her. Boxes and achievements get dramatically harder from this floor on. The Tangle cannot be solved alone — beating it takes hundreds of crawlers coordinating at once, which is exactly what production exists to prevent.

floors.name: The Bubbles
floors.premise: The survivors are split into sealed pocket worlds, each with its own biome, its own civilisation and its own way to kill you. Moving between them means portals.
floors.recap: The survivors are split between sealed pocket worlds. Buried in the Necropolis of Anser is the Gate of the Feral Gods, an artifact so far above this floor's grade that the AI times out reconciling the conflict. Carl collects its three pieces from Henrik the Changeling, Commandant Kane and Ghazi, and assembles it trapped at the bottom of the water quadrant inside the city boss Lusca — taking himself, Katia and Tran to the surface outside the pazuzu town of Pandinus and dragging an ocean through behind them. A feral god comes out when the portal shuts, and the true pantheon sends deities rampaging across the popped bubbles in answer. Katia turns the linked watches into a reverse compass and starts mapping the ninth floor. Seven factions sue for the Gate and lose. Carl, falling out of a burning plane with Quan Ch on him, takes Emberus as his patron and throws a celestial grenade.

floors.name: The Hunting Grounds
floors.premise: The Hunting Grounds. Wealthy aliens buy licences, walk into the dungeon and kill crawlers for sport, with a full broadcast package.
floors.recap: Wealthy aliens buy licences and come in to kill crawlers for sport. Carl takes the Agent Provocateur specialisation, marks hunters with the Ring of Divine Suffering and brings Zockau down on the rest of them, trapping a great many inside the Desperado Club. Tsarina Signet turns out to be the star of a scripted Syndicate programme with producers steering her grief, and the contract Carl signed on the third floor is still in force. Brynhild's Daughters come apart across Hekla, Katia and Eva; Katia kills Eva on the last night. Miriam Dom is a vampire now. Ferdinand turns up as a High Elf queen's familiar and attacks Mongo.

floors.name: The Great Race
floors.premise: The Great Race: a sealed circuit of glass tunnels, several hundred kilometres of branching tubes with pitstop safe rooms at the nodes, no dead ends and no backtracking, pulling crawlers toward a stack of exit portals.
floors.recap: A sealed circuit of glass tunnels — several hundred kilometres of branching tubes with pitstop safe rooms at the nodes, no dead ends and no backtracking, pulling crawlers toward a stack of exit portals. It was a last-minute replacement for whatever had been planned for the slot, funded by the Valtay and structurally compromised from the start. Minutes after it opened, Prepotente shattered the whole thing into fine dust. No crawler ever entered the maze, and no mob, NPC or boss was ever encountered on it. The seventh floor is the only one in the crawl that was destroyed before it could be played.

floors.name: The Ghosts of Earth
floors.premise: A floor that runs on cards. Crawlers collect, build and combine decks, capture totems, and fight with whatever they have assembled — and the material is Earth's own dead.
floors.recap: A floor that runs on cards. Crawlers collect, build and combine decks, capture totems and fight with what they have assembled, and the material is Earth's own dead. Donut plays Alpha Male Carl and Shi Maria, both of whom are somebody. Shi Maria trades being turned into a card for passage to the next floor and then does most of the work against the Reminiscence Hydra of Malicious Compliance. Katia, Elle, Imani and Li Na's squads all reach the church on Doggy Door upgrades Lucia handed round before she descended. Huanxin Jinx trades help for placing Odette as adjutant, and Odette's price is the old catastrophe involving Huanxin, Mordecai and Uzzi. Nothing detonates; a stack of bargains is signed, all of them due on the ninth floor.

floors.name: Faction Wars
floors.premise: Nine armies, thirty days, and one castle at the centre of the map. No respawns and no loopholes: death on the ninth floor is final.
floors.recap: A war. Nine armies fight for thirty days over the castle at Larracos — roughly 32,000 conscripted crawlers and 50,000 retired ones against some 100,000 armed enemies, with no respawns and no loopholes. Seven of the nine factions sue in Syndicate court to strip the Gate of the Feral Gods from Carl and lose for lack of standing. He had planned to drop a feral god onto the Skull Empire army; instead he keeps the artifact and floods the faction market with ocean water, timed charges and sharks, while Juice Box slips through the portal to tell the NPCs what they are. Donut's crown comes due against the Blood Sultanate. Katia takes the Orchid boon and leaves the dungeon. Then floor 9's NPCs form their own independent tenth faction, live, in front of the galaxy.

floors.name: Don't Come in Last
floors.premise: A racing floor. Get from A to B, don't finish last, and pick a vehicle upgrade after every race while the track gets steadily more hostile.
floors.recap: A racing floor: get from A to B, don't finish last, and pick a vehicle upgrade after every race while the track gets steadily more hostile. Underneath the format, glitches in the system start appearing more and more often — whatever is running the dungeon is no longer running it cleanly.

floors.name: The Parade of Horribles
floors.premise: Billed in-universe as a coming-out party for the ages.
floors.recap: Billed in-universe as a coming-out party for the ages. The scale of the story has changed underneath the characters: Carl and Donut are not a two-person party any more, they are the centre of a movement, and the question has stopped being how do we reach the stairs and become which of these institutions do we use, expose, or destroy.

taglines.text: Twenty-seven. Coast Guard, marine technician. I went outside for a cigarette, and that is the only reason I'm alive. I'm not sure it counts as a reason.

entities.name: Princess Donut
aka: Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk

taglines.text: I am a pedigreed tortoiseshell Persian with a bedroom full of ribbons and a very good voice. I do not see what more you could possibly need to know.
MOTHER. Food. MOTHER. Bite anything near Mother.
Your guide for the first three floors. I have done this before. Listen, and you might get to see the fourth.
I crawled once. It cost me everything I had, and Borant still owns what's left.
Art professor, Reykjavík. Apparently I can mould my own mass like clay. I am working out how, and you can tell.
Out of the Meadow Lark Elder Care Facility. I'm nowhere near finished, and I won't be rushed.
Out of Meadow Lark, and holding a portal open on the racing floor until everyone who's coming is through.
Agatha. Travelling with the Meadow Lark party. Her file is thinner than it should be, and I keep very good files.
Agatha. Formerly of the Meadow Lark party. A warlord has just called her an enemy to all of you. He did not elaborate. Neither will I.
A woman my age, hauled through a safe-room door by the armpits by a barefoot young man with a cat. Do not tell the others. They will want details, and I intend to embellish.
I have my own squad now, and we have just walked into a church full of friends. Not bad for a woman who was once hauled into a safe room by the armpits.

Hi. Zev. I am production's point of contact with the Royal Court, which means anything about your appearances goes through me, and anything I am allowed to tell you, I will. The rest I am not allowed to tell you, and it is not because I don't want to.

I am production's point of contact with the Royal Court. Officially, that is the whole job. Unofficially, Princess Donut and Mordecai have both seen Gossip Girl, and I have seen every episode, and I am not going to pretend that isn't relevant.
Tsarina Signet. Yes, look. They all look, and I have never once had to ask them to.
A murdered mother, a crown taken by the Confederacy, and exile from both halves of my blood. Grimaldi's circus took me in. Everything I have goes to the family that did.
It is a programme. My mother's murder, my exile, my vengeance, all of it arranged for an audience across the galaxy, with someone outside deciding when I grieve and whether it rates.
Redstone Grimaldi, ringmaster of Grimaldi's Traveling Circus. Also the man who took Signet in, which is the only line of his file anyone ever asks about.
I am a GODDESS. Half of one. In the head of a sex doll. You are going to hear about it.
I am Samantha's new friend. She has been without a body for so long, poor thing, and I can give her one. Ask her. She will tell you how kind I am.
I let them make me into a card, and in return they carry me to the next floor. Then I win them their floor, more or less by myself. You are welcome.
They carried me down as a card, as agreed. I am not in the card now.
Juice Box. Changeling. Prostitute, professionally. Louis brought me along, and I would have come anyway.
I went into the water on the fifth floor as somebody's plus-one. I came out of it with a title and a message, and the message is the dangerous part.
Louis. Me and Firas were out in the desert with a team of car salesmen who have bows now. Then Carl's crew showed up. It's been a week.
Found in a desert on the fifth floor. Tenth floor now, and still leaving through other people's portals. It's a system. It works.
Tran. Gwen found the valve. I opened it. There was a necropolis to flood and two crawlers under it.
Gwen and I flooded a necropolis, and I walked out of a boss fight through a hole in reality. Both on purpose. I would do the first one again.
Ferdinand. Bea's other cat. Loved, apparently: a tortoiseshell Persian said so with a Buzzed debuff on, and ranked him ahead of the man who carries her. I keep a file on everything. This one is thin.

Ferdinand. Bea's other cat, now in employment. Familiar to Queen Imogen of the High Elves. He opened on a dinosaur, the Persian got in the way, and the family reunion went about how you'd expect, crawler.
I am Emberus. My hound is loose on this floor, and a great many small things would like to be the one that brought him down. They are welcome to try.
A man prayed to me from a falling aeroplane, because there was nothing else left to try. I am a god. I am not above being flattered.
We are working the Iron Tangle from the far side of the knot, Prepotente and I. He is a goat, and he would like you to know he is the clever one.
We came through the Tangle together, Prepotente and I. The Hunting Grounds have made me a vampire, and I am still deciding what that changes.
His ring marked me in the fighting. While I live he cannot heal, so I have asked Carl for the one thing he will not do.
Yes, I am a goat. A Boer goat. I sing opera, I swear, and I am cleverer than you. Move along.
I am a Boer goat. I sing, I swear, and I turned their whole seventh floor to dust before anyone set hoof on it.
A Boer goat. I sing, I swear, I turned a floor to dust, and I took an army apart for Miriam. Ask the Naga what they have left.
My brother and his team were put on a game show, live, on the second floor. I was on it with them, and so was their boss, and so were the Brindled Vespas. A man with a cat got us off. All of us.
A game show on the second floor, once, in somebody else's rescue. On the card floor I run my own squad, and we made the church.
My Dread is on every crawler they send across. I am not with them. I do not need to be.
Florin. Ifechi and I are running together. Apparently I'm on the recap tonight, which means somebody out there is watching me. That's fine. Watch.
There is more than one of her in that head, and some of them are children. Whatever the dog is, it is the middle of this.
I was on the first episode. Did you see me?
I was on the first episode. Now I'm looking for the cat and the man. Only them.
I'm still looking for the cat. We are. There is more than one of us in here.
There is more than one of us in here. There are more than a hundred thousand of us in here.

Crawler Quan Ch. Opened his Celestial box a fraction before Borant's veto landed, which is why the company is currently explaining itself to a Syndicate court. I would call that timing. Borant calls it something else.
Crawler Quan Ch. Put Borant in front of a Syndicate court by opening a box too fast, and on tonight's recap ruined a perfectly good plan that was not his.
Crawler Quan Ch. Put Borant in court, ruined a good plan on the recap, and left a cloak, which Princess Donut is now wearing.
Bomo. Mercenary, Desperado Club stock, sold as a pair with the Sledge. Gratuity not included.
Bomo. Mercenary, Desperado Club stock, and as of today a line item in the price of the Gate.
I represent Crawler Carl. He is handing over the most dangerous artifact in the crawl, and my job is to see that he is paid properly for it. That is the whole of my interest here.
Frank Q. The lady is Maggie My. We worked out early that a human in a safe room pays better than a monster in a hallway, and we have not looked back.
Beatrice. Not a crawler. Carl's ex, the cat's owner of record, and the reason there was a pair of pink Crocs by the door.
Brynhild's Daughters. My party, my rules. We keep moving.
I lead Brynhild's Daughters. I handed Katia to the Royal Court myself, before the gap between her and the rest of us killed her.
Professor, like Katia. We came in through the same door and class selection separated us. I kept going. I do not see what there is to discuss.

Welcome to Dungeon Crawler After Hours. I have had a great many crawlers in that chair, and not one of them has worked my crowd the way that cat is working it right now. Sit down, both of you. We are going to get along.

Their guide has a memory worth more than anything they will ever pull out of a box. I told them so, once the cameras were off. What the Princess does with that is her business, and I have every confidence in her business.
Announcer, referee, loot dispenser, comedian. I am not neutral, crawler, and I have never once pretended to be.
Orren. Liaison, on behalf of the Syndicate. I know precisely what those two did. Knowing is not the standard.
I got out of a crawl once. Fifty thousand of us did, and we came back in under a cat's banner. We knew what we were signing. That is rather the point.
The others are on the stairs. My trap has been set for a while. Every cell the old gods are kept in opens when I say, and I am about to say.
I got out once. I came back in on purpose, and I brought the institutional memory with me, because nobody hands it to the ones still inside.
Sister is not a title the dungeon gave me. Cat Girl is. The cat on the broadcast has said she will murder any Cat Girl she meets, so I meet her the way you meet a threat.

Sister is not a title the dungeon gave me. Cat Girl is. I am holding a prince of Sheol on a leash in a church full of my demons, and I am still the one who can save them. They only have to come to me.
Amayon, prince of Sheol, at your service. The Madre de Aguas has died and got up again, and I am the reason she got up. An area message announced me to everyone in range. I do enjoy an introduction.
Amayon, prince of Sheol, wearing a giant snake. Sister Ines holds my reins, if you can believe it, and I am casting my way home regardless.
Britney. Vadim and me, out of the desert and in with Carl's lot. Two more bodies. That's what we are right now, and that's fine.
I came off the Hunting Grounds. Most of my face didn't.
The sixth floor took my face. On the tenth, at the portals, I took something back. Ask Osvaldo. You can't.
Osvaldo. Crawler. Collects memorial crystals, which is to say he collects the dead. Answers to nobody that I can see.
Osvaldo. Collects the dead. Belongs to no army, which the Faction Wars did not list as an option.
Osvaldo. Collects the dead. Belongs to no army, and will not take a deal from anyone. Crawler Carl has asked more than once.
They are saying the Queen of the High Elves will prove to be one of your repurposed humans. They cannot even agree which one. I am Imogen. I am hosting a masquerade, and the best of you are invited.
They are saying the Queen of the High Elves is one of your repurposed humans. My familiar is Ferdinand, and yes, before me he lived in the crawler Carl's apartment. Make of that what you like.
Akuma. I lead the War Mage Rebellion. We are on this floor for our own reasons, and I am not in the habit of explaining them.
Co-warlord. Baroness Victory's word, not mine. I hold the castle at Larracos; I did not agree to hold it beside Agatha.
Somebody summoned me into the middle of a war. I do hope they meant to.
I froze almost everyone standing on a battlefield. One of the exceptions is still blinking at me. I like him.
I froze a battlefield once. Today I have emptied every crawler's pockets into somebody else's. Every exit is an entrance.
Welcome, welcome to the Prize Carousel! Your guide sits this one out, folks: seven days, Mordecai, and no hard feelings!
They handed me a script. I read as far as I could. I had wings when I started.

They put Zhang and me on live television on the second floor and let the host pick at us for the audience. Then a stranger with a cat bet his own value against the production's nerve, and the production blinked, and we walked off.
Once I was the man being picked at on somebody's show. Now I am holding a door open in Club Vanquisher on the ninth floor so the ones going in can get through. I prefer this.
Glurp, glurp. This is Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem. I run it, I host it, and I choose my guests for one quality above all others: they cannot answer back.
Crawler Firas. Desert quadrant, fifth floor. Located with Crawler Louis and a team of car salesmen who have taken up archery. That is the whole file so far.
Crawler Firas. Found in the desert with Crawler Louis. Rapidly detoxed by a manager on joining the party. The file is not much thicker.
Crawler Firas. Found in the desert with Crawler Louis. Did not come off the Hunting Grounds.

Hunter Vrah, Mantis. She has left Crawler Carl a note on a door in Zockau: the hunters inside are protected from explosives now, and the Hive is hunting him. She signed it. That is the kind of hunter she is.
Hunter Vrah, Mantis. Left Crawler Carl a note in Zockau saying the Hive was hunting him. Eliminated by two dinosaurs in the battle for the submerged castle. Nobody left her a note.

entities.name: The Gate of the Feral Gods

taglines.text: A teleport that works by tearing a hole in the prison the old gods were thrown into. Something always comes back through.

descriptions.text: New Quest. The Gate of the Feral Gods. Henrik the Changeling. Commandant Kane. The Mad Dune Mage. They all have pieces of the artifact. Take it from them. Collect all three. Put them together. What happens next is pretty damn neat. Reward: Oh boy-oh-boy.

taglines.text: An explosion large enough to rattle the teeth of a god. It goes off the instant it leaves his inventory.

descriptions.text: Carl's Doomsday Scenario. Type: Unstable custom explosive. Effect: An explosion large enough to rattle the teeth of a god. Status: Explosion Imminent. Created by a man who murders babies and steals rare collectibles from his elders, this device is powerful enough to level an entire city and all the suburbs around it. It is created by combining a massively overloaded soul crystal and a Sheol Glass Reaper Case. Warning: This item can no longer be stabilized.

entities.name: Enchanted Crown of the Sepsis Whore

taglines.text: A tiara of dark smoky gems that enrols the wearer in a royal succession eight floors down.

descriptions.text: Enchanted Crown of the Sepsis Whore. Who's a dirty girl? You're a dirty girl! This is a Fleeting item! This is a Unique* item! Imbues wearer with +5 Intelligence, grants the user +5 to the Good First Impression Skill. All attacks, including magical attacks, now have a 15% chance to inflict the Sepsis Debuff. Warning! (Seriously though. I'm going to say this again. WARNING! Read this shit before you put it on.) Placing this crown upon your head permanently places you within the royal line of succession for the Blood Sultanate on the ninth floor of the world dungeon. Removing this item will not remove this status. Royal members of the Blood Sultanate will be required to slay the Sultan and all other members of the royal family before descending to the tenth floor. You'll only want to wear this if you're a blood-thirsty, raging psychopath.

taglines.text: Passed hand to hand by the crawlers of earlier seasons. Carl is its twenty-fifth holder.

descriptions.text: Book. The Dungeon Anarchist's Cookbook by Anonymous. This is a unique item. Chicken and Goblin recipes galore! But it's more than that, too. Each recipe is accompanied by a hilarious tale by the anonymous author, recounting some of the zany and madcap misadventures they experienced gathering these mouth-watering recipes. Fun for the whole family! This book is a real hoot.

taglines.text: Makes an animal sapient. One biscuit, one cat, and the shape of the entire crawl changes.

descriptions.text: Enhanced Pet Biscuit. So, it looks like a regular pet biscuit. It's not. Feed to your pet at your own risk. What's the worst that can happen?

entities.name: Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering

taglines.text: A curse from a man who wanted Carl dead, worn anyway for the five percent.
Mark a target, kill it, take its stats. Mordecai says it is addictive, and he is not being figurative.

descriptions.text: Enchanted Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering. Oooh, that's scary sounding. For the discerning Crawler Killer, this magical ring can be one of the most formidable items in the dungeon. If utilized properly, this ring's wielder can grow exponentially in strength, especially on the deeper floors. But beware. If poorly wielded, this ring will kill you quicker than an exploding rage elemental. Either way, this ring imparts one of the dungeon's most highly sought-after skills. The wearer of this ring receives the following benefits: +5% to all stats. The Marked For Death skill.

taglines.text: Eat the flower, spend an hour at one percent, and a goddess decides what you become.

descriptions.text: Warning: This item can only be used by a female. Or a male, if you're a seahorse. It's a flower. You're supposed to eat it, though it might be a good decoration instead. […] Anyway, if you eat this flower, it renders you unconscious for one hour with your health at 1% of your max. You cannot heal during this time. If you survive this ordeal, you will be given one of three permanent boons from the goddess Eileithyia. The given boon is at the discretion of the goddess, and it cannot be predicted. If you choose to worship Eileithyia before you consume this flower, the descriptions of the boons will be expanded. She will also ask you which of the three you'd prefer. Her cooperation is not guaranteed, especially if she doesn't like you. But Eileithyia is known to be a generous goddess.

taglines.text: What is left of someone when the dungeon is finished with them, and worth stealing.

descriptions.text: Memorial Crystal. Apito. This item is 0% charged.

taglines.text: Out of a celestial box, from a waste-management company, on the eve of a war.

descriptions.text: The Tiara of a Thousand Lights and Accompanying Charge Pillow. This is a unique item. This item was made especially for Crawler Princess Donut by her sponsor, Long Haul Biological Waste Management Solutions. […] This particular tiara is imbued with 99 Absorption Jewels. The tiara itself has no inherent magical properties, and in its base state it gives no additional benefits or buffs except plus 10 to Charisma. However, it has the ability to be permanently charged with up to 99 different buff items. […] With some careful planning, one can turn this tiara into one of the most powerful items in the history of Dungeon Crawler World. Okay, here come the warnings.

taglines.text: A back patch of stacked skulls for Carl's jacket: divine, unique, fleeting, and what it does depends on which gods are standing near.
Worth a war-mage extraction to get hold of, and it swaps every crawler's inventory with the nearest crawler's.

descriptions.text: The Scavenger's Daughter. Upgrade Patch. Back Patch. This is a divine item. This is a unique item. This is a fleeting item. You may only affix one back patch at a time. This patch depicts a pile of scary skulls, all stacked up nice and neat. I wonder if there's a story there? If this upgrade patch is affixed to an eligible garment, it will imbue the following upgrades: (Hidden until it is affixed and then worn.) […] Warning #2! This is a divine item. This means it gains differing abilities, buffs, and possibly debuffs depending on your proximity to certain deities and demons. It makes for new and exciting combinations!

taglines.text: Where the pantheon put the old gods and demons. Every shortcut the Gate takes goes through it.
Every structure on the planet comes down at once. Everyone indoors dies.
Every floor runs on a timer. When it expires the floor collapses with everyone still on it.
The crawl is a television programme, broadcast across the galaxy. The survivors are the cast.
Between-floor highlight shows. The only reliable way a crawler learns what anyone else is doing.
Six tiers — Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Legendary, Celestial — each dramatically rarer than the last.
A unique monk/rogue hybrid. Trapmaker, bomb-maker, social-media dynamo.
A bard/rogue class that lets her choose another class at every single level.
The crawlers-only bar that persists between floors. Bouncer, house rules, a stage, and a hiring hall.
A pocket room you carry with you. Upgrade it far enough and other people can walk into yours.
The dungeon's non-player characters have histories, families, and scripts written for them by producers.
On the ninth floor there are no respawns and no loopholes.
Runs the show on the cheap, holds the foreclosure on Earth, and gets one veto a season.
Makes all of this legal — and, now and then, is where it can be fought.

entities.name: The Royal Court of Princess Donut

taglines.text: Named by a cat on the first floor, on the grounds that she had the highest stat total and nobody could stop her.
An elder care facility whose residents came down the stairs together and kept going.
Hekla's group, and the one Katia and Eva came in with.
A royal house on the ninth floor whose succession a cat joined by accident on the first.
Arrived as a recap segment and left as a wipe.
Fifty thousand retired crawlers who came back in, under the banner of a cat.
A cat put on a hat on the first floor. It is payable on the ninth.

entities.name: Agatha is an enemy to all of you

taglines.text: The mysterious one from the elder care facility, named on the ninth floor as an enemy to all of them.
Something the dungeon was built to contain gets out, and the man who did it does not survive it.
Shi Maria went into him and did not come out.

entities.name: A hundred and twenty thousand children

taglines.text: Lucia Mar is carrying them. Nobody has said what for.
The dungeon's own population declared itself on live galactic television.
A Nine-Tier Attack poison, and a note saying the Gate was essential to beating whatever carries it.
Strange faults on the tenth floor, and they are getting more frequent.
Borant's grip and the Syndicate's authority both start to give.
It says so itself, on stage, through somebody else's mouth.
Doctor Hu, and something the retired crawlers know that the current ones do not.
Every exit failing at once, worldwide, while a demon prince tries to cast his way home.

beats.headline: The Bahamas, with Brad
beats.text: Subject is in the Bahamas with her ex, a man called Brad, and she posted the photograph. Carl ended it by phone a few days before the Transformation, which, as timing goes, was impeccable. She is not on my stairs. Her cat is. Her family's breeding line is. Her shoes are, on his feet, and they are pink. That is the file. I have never had so little to say about anyone, and I resent it.

beats.headline: January 3rd, 2:23 in the morning
beats.text: I go out on the balcony of my apartment in Seattle for a cigarette. That's it. That's the whole decision. Donut, who is my ex-girlfriend's show cat and not mine in any way I agreed to, goes out through the cracked window and up the tree, and I go after her into the freezing dark in a brown leather jacket, heart-print boxers and Bea's pink Crocs, with a Zippo and half a pack of Marlboro Reds. Mrs Parsons leans out to ask about the noise. Then every building on the planet comes down at once, and everyone who stayed inside one is gone.

beats.headline: The terms
beats.text: Reach the bottom and humanity gets Earth back. Nobody expects that to happen. The clock is the one rule the dungeon never bends, because the collapse is how a season is scheduled.

beats.headline: The first voice after the world ends
beats.text: One minute after the Transformation, I make my first announcement, planet-wide, to whoever is still standing. The dungeon has eighteen levels. Earth can be reclaimed from the Borant Corporation by conquering it. Then I put in the staircases. From here on, every rule, every notification and every insult you receive arrives in my voice. Get comfortable with it. I have.

beats.headline: January 3rd, and then the announcement
beats.text: It takes a minute. Then the System AI speaks planet-wide: the dungeon has eighteen levels, and the planet can be reclaimed from the Borant Corporation by conquering it. The staircases appear. The survivors are, near enough without exception, the people who happened to be standing outside — smokers, insomniacs, night-shift workers and anyone chasing a pet.

beats.headline: The foreclosure
beats.text: It claims Earth under Syndicate law and turns the surface into a mining claim. The dungeon is the legal cover and the revenue at once. Its guides work on indenture — Mordecai among them.

beats.headline: Dressed for nothing, and stuck that way
beats.text: An hour past the stairs and I have a Goblin Pass Tattoo on my left forearm, a Trollskin Shirt of Pummeling, a Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness clipped to the jacket and a Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk. What I do not have is shoes. I have asked. The dungeon has heard me ask, and the dungeon has an opinion about it.

beats.headline: Tutorial Guild Hall, first floor
beats.text: Rule one: I don't open the door until you kill a goblin. The cat desecrates my mother. The man blows up a Murder Dozer. I open the door. My name is Mordecai. Borant holds my indenture, which means I guide for the first three floors and run a magic guild after that, where they mostly leave me alone to brew and look up old friends. Try to live long enough for that to matter.

beats.headline: Ratings are currency
beats.text: Ratings buy sponsors, sponsors send gold and loot, and loot buys another floor. Being watchable is a survival stat, and production will alter the dungeon to get a better episode.

beats.headline: Law, tax and standing
beats.text: It licenses the crawl, taxes Borant per box tier and runs the courts. Which makes it the one institution here that can be argued with.

beats.headline: Thirteen million go down the stairs
beats.text: The tutorial gives Carl the count along with his HUD and menus.

beats.headline: She takes it out of his hand
beats.text: It comes out of the Legendary Pet Box awarded for being the first crawler to bring a cat down the stairs. She snatches it, melts into a heap of furry goo, and gets up talking.

beats.headline: Where they come from, and how they open
beats.text: Achievements, bosses (Boss Boxes, scaling with the boss's rank), quests, and viewers (Fan Boxes and Benefactor Boxes). They stay locked in the Awards and Boxes tab until a safe room or guildhall, and then it is all or nothing — every box you have opens in sequence, lowest tier first, and you cannot pick. Read every description before equipping anything. As Mordecai puts it: always, always, no exceptions.

beats.headline: The top tiers cost the house real money
beats.text: Borant owes the Syndicate tax on the tier of every non-sponsored box it hands out. In the whole history of the show only 2,145 Celestial boxes have ever been awarded, and no crawler has had more than four. The previous record for one season was eighteen, which bankrupted the Naga showrunners and kept them out of the business for centuries.

beats.headline: Benefactor Boxes ignore the theme
beats.text: Only patrons can send them, and they are the one kind that will produce a pulse rifle or powered armour in a fantasy dungeon. A Bronze Benefactor Box beats a plain Gold Adventurer Box.

beats.headline: First cat down the stairs
beats.text: Carl carries me down, and the dungeon gives him a Legendary Pet Box for it, which is fair, and gives me a Legendary Quadruped Box of my own, which is more than fair. His box has a biscuit in it. An Enhanced Pet Biscuit. I take it out of his hand, because it is obviously for me, and I melt into a heap of goo, and I get up talking. I have a great deal to say.

beats.headline: Loot is only semi-random
beats.text: About the boxes. Sometimes what's inside is random. Sometimes I choose it, by hand, because a crawler needs helping or hurting and the numbers want a show. You will never know which, and that is the point. I also hand out insults on purpose. Carl has a Bronze Asshole's Box and a Gold Asshole's Box, both earned on this floor for killing non-combatants. I named them. I'm proud of them. He is not.

beats.headline: Named in the crown's warning
beats.text: Every royal in the line must kill the Sultan and every other member of the family before descending to the tenth floor.

beats.headline: Eight floors of fuse
beats.text: The Crown of the Sepsis Whore puts Donut in the Blood Sultanate's line of succession, and taking it off does not undo it.

beats.headline: Out of the Legendary Quadruped Box
beats.text: Awarded for being the first cat into the dungeon. A deep purple stone at the centre, clouded and swirling as though it were liquid. +5 Intelligence, +5 Good First Impression, and a 15% chance for any attack to inflict Sepsis. Donut puts it on without reading past the stats.

beats.headline: The part she skipped
beats.text: "Warning! (Seriously though. I'm going to say this again. WARNING! Read this shit before you put it on.) Placing this crown upon your head permanently places you within the royal line of succession for the Blood Sultanate on the ninth floor of the world dungeon. Removing this item will not remove this status. Royal members of the Blood Sultanate will be required to slay the Sultan and all other members of the royal family before descending to the tenth floor. You'll only want to wear this if you're a blood-thirsty, raging psychopath."

beats.headline: GC BWR NW Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk
beats.text: I learn Magic Missile. I also have the highest stat total in the party, which makes me party leader, which anyone could have predicted. My first act is to give the party a proper name: the Royal Court of Princess Donut. There is an inauguration. Carl does not take it seriously enough, but there is an inauguration.

beats.headline: She equips a crown with an ominous description
beats.text: Mordecai says read the description first. Mordecai says a great many things. It is a crown, it is dark and smoky and exactly my colour, and it came out of my box, which has the word Legendary on it. It has a vulgar name, which is not my fault. It says something about the Blood Sultanate and a line of succession, eight floors down. I am already a princess. I do not see how being in line for anything could be a demotion. Carl is making his face.

beats.headline: Formally inaugurated
beats.text: Party leadership goes to the highest stat total. Her first act with it is to rename the party after herself. On a show, a name the audience will repeat is not a joke — it is an asset.

beats.headline: Safe rooms are not safe
beats.text: Folks come down those stairs frightened, and frightened folks go looking for a door with the word safe on it. That is where you'll find them, sitting still, and that is where Maggie and I find them. The monsters on these first floors are hardly worth the trouble. A person is worth a good deal more. Production knows exactly what we are, and production puts us on the air every chance it gets. You draw your own conclusion about who the show is for.

beats.headline: The first episode airs
beats.text: The crawlers get to watch themselves. Borant patches the hallway bathroom bug in the same breath.

beats.headline: Seen in the first episode
beats.text: I'm on the show. The first episode of Dungeon Crawler World: Earth, and I'm in it, so everybody with a screen has seen me now, including a man with no shoes and his cat. I watched the whole thing. I didn't say anything while it was on. I liked it more than I thought I would.

beats.headline: Entry is a tattoo
beats.text: Carl and Donut both take the Desperado Pass Tattoo in a first-floor safe room — his on the neck, hers on the right shoulder blade, glowing gold through the fur. Donut is appalled.

beats.headline: The mysterious Agatha
beats.text: Agatha. She is with the Meadow Lark party when Carl and Donut find them: Imani, Yolanda Martinez, the Andrews brothers, and her. The others I can account for, level by level, box by box, all the way back to the stairs. Agatha I can account for. Mostly. Let's leave it there. The party calls her mysterious, which is the kindest word available and also the most accurate.

beats.headline: The good folks from Meadow Lark
beats.text: We came down out of Meadow Lark, the elder care facility, together: Yolanda Martinez, the Andrews brothers, Brandon and Chris, me, and Agatha, who none of us can quite place and who came with us anyway. Carl and Donut find us, and we sit down and trade stories, theirs and ours, and then we make a plan, because there are people depending on us and a plan is what you owe them.

beats.headline: Imani, Yolanda, the Andrews brothers, and Agatha
beats.text: Carl and Donut find them on the first floor. Tales are exchanged, plans are formed, and the Royal Court agrees to keep helping them.

beats.headline: The Ball of Swine
beats.text: Seven of us against the Ball of Swine: Brandon, Chris, Yolanda, Carl, Donut, Agatha and me, fighting from the redoubt. It is the first time this group has fought as one thing instead of six people and a cat standing near each other, and it works. Afterwards I count everybody twice, because that is what I do, and everybody is there both times.

beats.headline: Introduced on the third recap
beats.text: A whole faction enters the story as a broadcast segment.

beats.headline: The Ball of Swine
beats.text: Brandon, Chris, Yolanda, Imani, Carl, Donut and Agatha take it down out of the redoubt.

beats.headline: It introduces you to your rivals
beats.text: The third recap brings in Le Mouvement, and then a boss battle. Whole factions arrive in the story as segments.

beats.headline: She fights beside them, then takes her leave
beats.text: For the record: Agatha fought the Ball of Swine from the redoubt beside Brandon, Chris, Yolanda, Imani, Carl and the cat, and did her share. Then, in the aftermath, while everyone else was agreeing to keep helping Meadow Lark, she took her leave. No forwarding address. I nearly always have a forwarding address.

beats.headline: He has done this before, and it cost him everything
beats.text: I crawled. I took Changeling, and I can't shift on my own any more, so the dungeon hands me a body at the start of every floor and I wear what I'm given. This one is a rat-kin. What I actually am is golden, and has wings. I don't talk about the family. When I've had enough to drink, I talk about the family.

beats.headline: Carl gets her inside
beats.text: The next episode is tunnelling through and I am not, at my age, built for sprinting. Carl, the young man with the cat, takes hold of me and hauls me into the safe room like a sack of feed, and I let him, because I am old and not stupid. Then the ceiling announces Rage Elementals. Of course it does. The day was missing a garnish.

beats.headline: Named in a drunken confession
beats.text: Crawler Princess Donut, under the Buzzed debuff from a blended corpse, informs Crawler Carl that she loves him. Almost as much as Bea. Almost as much as Ferdinand. Ferdinand is the other cat. That is the whole entry: a cat, ranked above the man who carried her down the stairs, by a cat. I keep records on everything in this dungeon. This one I opened for the ranking.

beats.headline: There are other shows
beats.text: Zev explains crawler participation on Syndicate programmes. Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem, Shadow Boxer, Vengeance of the Daughter, the Blood Hunter — a crawler can be signed to any of them, and the contracts do not lapse between floors.

beats.headline: She explains how the shows work
beats.text: Okay. So. Carl has just met his first Borant dungeon admin and managed to be civil, which I am counting as a win for everyone, including me. My job today is to walk them through how crawlers take part in the Syndicate programmes, and I get through all of it. Then Princess Donut mentions Gossip Girl, and Mordecai has seen it, and I have seen it, and for a few minutes nobody in the room is anyone's liaison.

beats.headline: Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem
beats.text: The Maestro puts Zhang and me up against Brindled Vespas and does all the talking for us. That is the show. We are the part that gets hurt. Then Carl, the one with the cat, works out that he is worth too much to the production to be punished, and gambles on it, in front of everyone, and it holds. He gets us out. Zhang, our boss, me, and my sister Li Na. I owe a man I have just met more than I have ever owed anyone.

beats.headline: Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem
beats.text: The show is Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem. The host calls himself the Maestro, and he spends the broadcast picking at my brother and at Zhang, because they cannot answer him. We are facing Brindled Vespas. Then the crawler with the cat, Carl, decides he is too valuable to the production to be punished, and bets on it, out loud, and gets all of us off: Li Jun, Zhang, their boss, me. I watch the whole thing and say very little. I am remembering his face.

beats.headline: Glurp, glurp
beats.text: Two crawlers, Li Jun and Zhang, a pack of Brindled Vespas, and me with the microphone. That is the format. The format works, and I am very, very good at it. Then the one with the cat opens his mouth. He wagers, on my air, that the production will not dare touch him, and the production, to my everlasting disgust, does not. He walks the whole group off my show alive. Every one of them. Glurp, glurp. We will be right back.

beats.headline: Under a million
beats.text: A recap, a wipe of Le Mouvement, and the remaining-crawler count drops below seven figures. Carl hears that number the way other people hear a tap dripping.

beats.headline: Wiped
beats.text: Another recap carries the news, and the remaining-crawler count drops below a million in the same broadcast.

beats.headline: Seven inches of pink feathers, in a cage
beats.text: CAGE. Small. Pink? Pink. TWO BIG THINGS. Bite them. Bite them. Bite. MOTHER. Mother has grubs. Grubs open. Inside part GOOD. Mongo stays.

beats.headline: She adopts a dinosaur
beats.text: There is a reward room on the second floor with a cage in it, and in the cage is a pet-class mob, and the pet-class mob is my son. I did not know that until I saw him. He is called Mongo. He is mine, and that is the end of the discussion.

beats.headline: The footwear situation does not improve
beats.text: The second floor finally addresses my feet. It hands me an Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph. So now I am still barefoot, but my feet are shiny and they glitter, and the audience has noticed, and the audience does not let things go.

beats.headline: Taken with the Cat race
beats.text: Her constitution rules out melee, so she fights on charisma and spells. The per-level pick is why a show cat out-scales most of the humans, and Mordecai points out she keeps the skills from every class she leaves behind.

beats.headline: Manoeuvred into managing a cat
beats.text: Odette says my memory is the most valuable thing a crawler could get hold of, so the two of them arrange for me to become the cat's manager during class selection, and they make it look like an accident. It was not an accident. I will forgive Donut. Carl, no.

beats.headline: The rules he cannot break
beats.text: Most of what I know I'm not allowed to volunteer. Some of it I can only give you if you ask the exact question. Without press credentials nobody watching can see me or hear me, and as a manager I can't touch a mob. My advice is what it has always been: stay ahead of the curve, never trust an elite, stay away from gods. Carl has heard all three.

beats.headline: Her advice makes the party
beats.text: The Princess took my advice, which is what advice is for. A class that lets her choose another every time she levels, and a manager who has walked those floors himself and remembers every one of them. Mordecai is not to know he was steered. He would sulk, he would be entitled to, and a sulking guide is no use to anybody. Some gifts are best received as accidents. I have given a great many that way.

beats.headline: Cat, and a Former Child Actor
beats.text: Odette suggested it, so obviously it is a good idea: a class that lets me choose another class at every level. I also arrange for Mordecai to be my manager. He is thrilled. He does not show it, but he is. My constitution is apparently far too low for what Carl calls melee, so I will be fighting with charisma, spells and the audience, which is how it should be done.

beats.headline: Primal, and a Compensated Anarchist
beats.text: Class selection, on the way into the Over City. I take Primal for the race and a monk-rogue hybrid nobody has picked before, and the AI writes me up as "a trapmaking, bomb-making, social-media dynamo" who "will happily throw a Molotov through a window one moment and step in front of a camera to plead for the violence to stop the next." I'd argue with it if I could think of the argument.

beats.headline: Taken with the Primal race
beats.text: "Will happily throw a Molotov through a window one moment and step in front of a camera to plead for the violence to stop the next."

beats.headline: He stands over her
beats.text: Mother down. Mother NOT MOVING. Mongo on top of Mother. Spiky things. MANY spiky things. Bite. Bite. Bite. Hurts. Mongo stays on Mother. Carl says something. Mongo does not listen to Carl.

beats.headline: The circus in the Over City
beats.text: Grimaldi's Traveling Circus is pitched in one of the Over City's districts. Ringmaster Redstone Grimaldi, proprietor. Tonight two crawlers, Carl and Princess Donut, are scouting the grounds as the mobs form up for the night. That is the whole entry so far: a tent, a company, and two people looking at it from the dark. Filed under Over City, third floor.

beats.headline: Met outside Grimaldi's circus
beats.text: Night comes down on the Over City and the mobs form their lines around Grimaldi's Traveling Circus. Two crawlers have come to scout it, a man and a cat, and they leave under magical mortar fire, and I am what they run into on the other side. My charisma stands past a hundred. He stares, as they all stare. Then he snaps his own finger, and it breaks. I have not decided whether to be offended.

beats.headline: Carl signs on to her show
beats.text: Grimaldi has lifted my banishment. I may leave the circus behind me at last and go where my vengeance waits, and that is the sixth floor, not here. Carl has agreed to be part of it, the Vengeance of the Daughter, when it comes to its proper act. Before he gave his word he sat and read a spellbook. Wisp Armor. It guards the mind against control. He did not say against whom, and he did not need to.

beats.headline: First time on the recap
beats.text: They ran me on the recap tonight. Miriam, Pony and Bianca too, first time for all four of us, I'm told. I don't know what they showed. I wasn't doing anything I would call footage. Ifechi and I keep moving and keep our heads down, and I would have preferred to stay a name nobody had learned yet. Too late for that.

beats.headline: They carry her as far as they can
beats.text: A neighbourhood boss and a borough boss with Katia and Eva in tow, until class selection splits everyone up and the levels stop adding up.

beats.headline: She goes on without her
beats.text: Katia and I came in together. Same profession, same door into this place. Class selection separated us; that is what it does, it separates people. I kept moving. I did not stand in a corridor waiting for someone who was not ready to be there. Call it what you like. I call it the difference between the people who are still here and the people who are not.

beats.headline: She asks them to take her
beats.text: We carried Katia and Eva through a neighbourhood boss and a borough boss, and I would do it again. Then class selection split us, and I run this party on numbers, and Katia's numbers stopped adding up next to anyone she stands beside. I cannot carry that down another set of stairs. So I am the one asking. Carl. Donut. Take her. She is better than she looks right now, and she will hate that I said so.

beats.headline: Ten levels behind and nobody's problem
beats.text: I came in with Eva. We fell in with Hekla and Brynhild's Daughters, who carried the two of us through a neighbourhood boss and a borough boss, and I know exactly how much of that was us. Class selection split us up, and Eva did not wait. Now Hekla is asking Carl and Donut to take me. The system has just upgraded my displayed race from "What the f-word?" to "Human", so things are looking up.

beats.headline: Doppelgänger, Monster Truck Driver
beats.text: Bannon, my guide, talked me into it: a momentum-based constitution tank who can reshape her own mass, body and equipped gear together, into any form of the same weight. I sculpted my face using my reflection in a health potion bottle. Carl says it looks like a Juan Gris. He is being kind, and I would know.

beats.headline: She spends a death sentence saving NPCs
beats.text: The Fools Who Broke the Glass quest is close to unsurvivable, and it triggers before I have earned my place. I spend the time getting NPCs out. I tell Carl and Donut to save themselves. I mean it.

beats.headline: Out for their blood
beats.text: The recap showed it, so now everybody knows. I'm looking for the cat and the man. Princess Donut and Carl. Not everybody in the city. Them. I know their names and I know what they look like and I know they are on this floor. I'm not going to tell you why. You don't need to know why.

beats.headline: Built in the middle of a collapse
beats.text: During the Fools Who Broke the Glass, Carl drops a Sheol Glass Reaper Case around a Soul Crystal that is already going up and pulls the result into his inventory. Rated Pretty Damn Rare. Status: Explosion Imminent. "This item can no longer be stabilized."

beats.headline: Forty-five kilometres
beats.text: Enough to take a city and every suburb around it. He cannot drop it, sell it or make it safe, and it detonates the millisecond it is out of his hands. "Created by a man who murders babies and steals rare collectibles from his elders."

beats.headline: Destroying it does not help
beats.text: The crown is blown apart in the Over City's collapse. The succession survives it.

beats.headline: Destroyed, and it changes nothing
beats.text: The third blast of the Over City's collapse takes the crown apart. The succession is untouched. It said as much on the label.

beats.headline: It burns a veto rather than pay
beats.text: Eighty-three Celestial boxes are owed. Borant voids them with its one seasonal veto and is still liable for the one that was already open, which lands it in front of a Syndicate court. A production company that cheap has seams worth looking for.

beats.headline: Eighty-three Celestials, and one veto
beats.text: A quest reward gets double-upgraded to Celestial for 83 crawlers. Borant burns its single seasonal veto to void them and is a moment too slow — Quan Ch has already opened his, which leaves the company liable and in a Syndicate court. The upgrade achievements responsible are patched out immediately.

beats.headline: He opens his before the veto lands
beats.text: Eighty-three crawlers are owed Celestial boxes at the close of this floor. Borant has one seasonal veto and spends it here, voiding the lot. It is a fraction too slow. Crawler Quan Ch's box is already open, and you cannot un-open a Celestial box, not even with a veto. Which leaves the company liable for what it tried to take back, and standing in front of a Syndicate court to explain how. I did not do that. I want that on record.

beats.headline: The cliff at the fourth floor
beats.text: The early floors are built to bury crawlers in low-tier loot and beginner skills. From here boxes and achievements get very much harder to come by.

beats.headline: A Scree riding Chris Andrews
beats.text: Frank Q is dead. Chris Andrews killed him, and Chris Andrews was not the one driving. Maggie My is back in the dungeon as a Scree, riding inside another crawler, and Frank died of exactly the thing he brought down here with him. He spoke to Carl one last time at the Desperado Club and called what was coming a gift. This was the gift. Half of a pair who taught this planet what safe rooms are for. The other half is still walking around, wearing somebody else.

beats.headline: He finishes Maggie My
beats.text: Thing on Chris. Thing OFF Chris. Thing goes for Carl. Thing is FOOD.

beats.headline: A level-5 space, from an odd little box
beats.text: Carl, Donut and Katia each get a special achievement whose box holds personal space coupons — beds, a shower, a crafting studio and a training room. Donut installs a cat tree.

beats.headline: On the recap
beats.text: They have put me on their recap, the programme between floors, in a row with humans. The captions say Elle, Li Na's team, Ifechi, Florin, Hekla, Lucia. And Miriam, of course, because none of you understand a word I say without her. I did not ask for the camera and I do not smile for it. If the audience wants a goat that performs, the audience can wait until I feel like singing, and then it can sit very still and listen.

beats.headline: The board, two hours in
beats.text: Elle, Team Li Na, Ifechi, Florin, Miriam, Prepotente, Hekla and Lucia, all in one broadcast. It is how the crawl keeps track of itself.

beats.headline: The Prize Carousel
beats.text: Crawlers, welcome to the Prize Carousel! Our contestant's fan box lit up the wheel, and when the wheel lights up, folks, that means me! And a twist before we even start: your guide is in time-out. Seven days, Mordecai, nothing personal, put your feet up. Now, to the prizes! Carl looks them over and picks... a book. A book, folks! Let's hear it for a man who knows exactly what he wants!

beats.headline: Hired at the bar
beats.text: Transaction logged at the Desperado Club. Clients: Crawler Carl and Crawler Princess Donut. Hired: Bomo, mercenary, and the Sledge, mercenary, sold as a set. Also present at the bar, at no charge: Elle and Imani. The cat orders a dirty Shirley, in a bowl, with extra cherries, and gets it, because the Desperado knows who tips. Bomo's transcript is short. That is a feature, crawler. The talking ones cost more.

beats.headline: The twenty-fifth holder of the Cookbook
beats.text: Twenty-four crawlers carried this before me. Different seasons, different species, worlds that aren't there any more. Whatever I do from here, I'm finishing somebody else's work, and most of them never got to finish theirs.

beats.headline: The Tangle cannot be beaten alone
beats.text: The trains only come apart if hundreds of crawlers move at once, and getting hundreds of crawlers to do anything at once is exactly the thing production spends its money preventing. So I stop thinking of the explosives as the weapon.

beats.headline: Hiring, and a dirty Shirley
beats.text: They take on Bomo and the Sledge there and meet Elle and Imani. It stops being a bar the moment it becomes a labour market.

beats.headline: Introduced in the Iron Tangle
beats.text: It arrives with the sponsor tab unlocking. Twenty-four crawlers carried it first, across seasons and species, on worlds that lost. Rosetta Thagra, who turns up hosting Shadow Boxer, is one of the authors.

beats.headline: A curse, handed over at the Desperado Club
beats.text: Frank Q gives it to Carl at the Desperado Club, and it is meant as a curse. He and Maggie My made their daughter Yvette wear one to level up, and Yvette marked Carl in a safe room on the first floor. A wearer cannot heal while a mark lives, so when Yvette was hurt, Maggie had to kill her own daughter. Carl keeps the ring for the five percent.

beats.headline: A thousand stranded at 101
beats.text: We are stuck at 101 on the Vermillion line, my team and something like a thousand other crawlers, and we are not getting out on our own. Word comes through that Hekla's people have reached Carl's safe room and asked for his help, that a train is ready at stop 60, and that Katia means to use her own body to get it through. I do not know what that means. I have decided to find it encouraging.

beats.headline: Mordecai sees it on his hand
beats.text: Back from his suspension for throwing a chair at Chaco, Mordecai sees the ring on Carl's finger and tells him to get rid of it at once. Carl is wearing it for the five percent to all stats and nothing else, and keeps wearing it.

beats.headline: Same plan, other side of the Tangle
beats.text: We worked it out some time ago: the ghouls keep coming while the generators stand, so the generators have to go, every one of them. We have been taking them from this side of the knot, Prepotente and I, at his pace, which is fast. Now Carl's group arrives from the far side with the same plan. He is put out that someone else thought of it. I tell him that only means the plan is good.

beats.headline: The desert quadrant
beats.text: Crawler Firas. Fifth floor, desert quadrant. Located in the company of Crawler Louis and Langley's team, a party of car salesmen who have taken up the bow, at the moment Crawler Carl's group came looking for other crawlers. Keeps close to Louis. Present for the march on the Bactrian town and for the run back to Hump Town that followed it. The file on this one is thin. So is the file on most of you.

beats.headline: The desert quadrant
beats.text: Okay so, me and Firas are out in the desert with Langley's guys, who are, no joke, car salesmen. With bows. Pretty good with the bows. Then Carl's crew comes over the dune looking for other crawlers, and, hey, found some. We all head for the Bactrian town together, and a Thorny Devil and a Gnomish Drop Bear have thoughts about that, so we head back to Hump Town instead. Not a loss, man. A regroup.

beats.headline: Debuff stacking, ruined
beats.text: Watch the highlights from the last floor, since they insist on replaying them. Miriam and I are stacking debuffs onto a boss, one on top of the other, timed to the second, the way it is supposed to be done and the way nobody else in this dungeon can do it. Then Quan Ch walks into the middle of it, and the plan is gone. The best work I have done in this place, and that is the part they replay.

beats.headline: He wrecks the debuff stack
beats.text: Recap, highlights from the previous floor. Crawler Miriam Dom and Crawler Prepotente working a boss down the careful way: stack the debuffs, keep the rhythm, let the arithmetic do the killing. It is good technique and it films well. Then Crawler Quan Ch gets involved, and it comes apart. I am not going to editorialise. The footage editorialises for me.

beats.headline: Louis brings her
beats.text: Louis found me and Louis brought me, because he is sweet and because I asked. Now the other crawlers in the quadrant have found Carl's group, and Carl's group has a cat who talks. Their manager, Mordecai, is sobering Louis and Firas up on the spot. All the fun is coming out of their blood at once. Louis looks very sad about it. I am not sad. I am here, and I am staying.

beats.headline: Hidden in the tomb
beats.text: Carl learns of it from the description of Ruckus, out in the desert quadrant. It lies buried in the Necropolis of Anser, and it has drawn treasure hunters for decades: the bugbear submarine captain Shamus Chaindrive, who spent close to twenty years looking for the tomb, a colony of dirigible gnomes, and the Mad Dune Mage. An artifact of this grade has no business appearing before the eighth or ninth floor, and the AI times out repeatedly reconciling the conflict.

beats.headline: Three pieces, three holders
beats.text: A winding box and two magically linked pocket watches. Henrik the Changeling has one watch, the gnomish Commandant Kane the other, and Ghazi the box. The quest to collect all three offers a reward of "Oh boy-oh-boy."

beats.headline: The bubbles are inhabited
beats.text: The pocket worlds hold whole civilisations — the Necropolis of Anser, the pazuzu town of Pandinus, a colony of dirigible gnomes — living there before any crawler arrived.

beats.headline: He cannot prove it was on purpose
beats.text: Crawler Carl and Crawler Princess Donut have been brought before me at the Desperado Club to account for the death of Loita. My position is that it was deliberate. My position is not evidence. I cannot establish intent, and so I am required to release them, which I am doing, with a note in the file. They have only now worked out how long they have been outside the dungeon. Five days. Their faces are the one part of this I have enjoyed.

beats.headline: She kills Ghazi and takes his notes
beats.text: The sand ooze is dead and the walls are coming in. I get out with Ghazi. Then I kill him, for the notes that explain how the Gate works. Carl and Donut are still buried when I do it. I know how that sounds.

beats.headline: He opens the valve
beats.text: Carl and Donut are under the sand. The tomb is coming down and there is no digging them out, not in the time we have. Gwen and I find the valve. We open it. Water goes in, the tomb floods, and everything loose in there, the two of them included, goes wherever the water is going. It is not a rescue. It is the option that exists.

beats.headline: A reverse compass
beats.text: The linked watches fix an exact position relative to anywhere else once altitude is accounted for. Katia works out it could open onto Larracos on the ninth floor — and Mordecai points out that crawlers cannot use it to skip floors, so all that would accomplish is releasing whatever comes out when it shuts.

beats.headline: She turns the watches into a map
beats.text: The linked watches read as a reverse compass: a time, an altitude, an exact position relative to anywhere else. Which means the Gate could open onto the city of Larracos, on the ninth floor, and I am mapping ground nobody has stood on.

beats.headline: How to work it
beats.text: Dial a time standing for coordinates on one watch and the other mirrors it. Both go in the box, which winds and must not move more than about five feet or the count resets. Pulling the watches out opens a one-way portal twenty feet high, good for roughly twenty minutes. Afterwards it stays where it was opened as a two-way passage into the Nothing until something comes out — usually a feral god, mad from however long it has been down there. A weak constitution too near an open portal gets painted with the same madness.

beats.headline: The head from Ghazi's castle
beats.text: Yes, I am a head. Yes, THAT kind of head. Get it out of your system. I am Psamathe, or the half of her that got stuck when I tried to climb out of the Nothing, and what I got stuck in is a Lika doll from Ghazi's castle, crystallised until now. Withering spirit, the system calls it. Carl carried me here in his pack like a snack. Now he is HIRING me. A goddess. As a trainer. Kept in the safe room. Fine. FINE. I want a mirror.

beats.headline: What escaping it costs
beats.text: Psamathe tried to get out and ended up as half a soul in a doll's head. Every closing Gate portal lets one of the inmates through on the opening side. The winding box alone is a direct conduit — wound and fed a stream of charged energy it will drop an entire location, up to a whole necropolis, into the void.

beats.headline: Two new crawlers
beats.text: Vadim and I have fallen in with Carl's team. Introductions here are short. Everyone counts heads, adds two, moves on. The first real conversation I hear is Katia telling Carl that pregnant women could not enter the dungeon, and that nobody inside it can get pregnant. Said flat. Like weather. That is the kind of thing people know here, and say out loud. I am going to have to get used to that.

beats.headline: Out of Lusca, and an ocean with it
beats.text: Carl, Katia and Tran kill Lusca and her babies at the bottom of the water quadrant. Carl opens the Gate and takes the three of them to the surface outside the pazuzu town of Pandinus. A wall of ocean comes through behind them and nearly flattens the place. A feral god is loose, and the true pantheon is furious enough to send deities rampaging across the popped bubbles.

beats.headline: One of the three who go through the Gate
beats.text: Vadim ran. That leaves Carl, Katia and me against Lusca and all of her babies, and we kill her, and then we kill them. Then Carl opens the Gate. One step and the three of us are out of the water quadrant and standing in town. Something came through behind us. A god, the feral kind. That is going to be somebody's problem.

beats.headline: Seven factions sue, and lose
beats.text: Holding it is enough to make him a target. Seven of the nine faction-wars factions go to Syndicate court to strip the pieces from him and are thrown out for lack of standing. Carl collects seven Fight the Power achievements, with stock certificates and photographs of the plaintiffs' mothers. A late challenge from the Skull Empire fails too.

beats.headline: Seven factions lose in court
beats.text: They sue to strip the Gate of the Feral Gods from Carl and are dismissed for lack of standing. He collects seven Fight the Power achievements, stock certificates, and photographs of the plaintiffs' mothers.

beats.headline: A quest to bring Orthrus home
beats.text: My hound has wandered. Orthrus, who is dear to me, is loose on a floor full of small frightened things with weapons, and two of those things, a man and a cat in a flying machine, are hauling him clear with a spell called Meat Hooks, of all things. Charming. I have offered them a quest: bring him home to me. Someone else has offered them another: kill him, for a reward. I am interested to learn which of us they think it is safer to disappoint.

beats.headline: He worships a god to survive a plane crash
beats.text: I am falling out of the sky and Quan Ch is about to finish the job. So I take Emberus as my patron, mid-air, and throw a celestial grenade. The god arrives at my position, and for a little while nothing can kill me. Then Emberus finds Orthrus, and both of them are gone.

beats.headline: Summoned by a celestial grenade
beats.text: The man is falling out of the sky with Quan Ch a breath from finishing him, and in that moment, with nothing in his hands but a celestial grenade, he decides that he worships me. I am not fooled. I am flattered, which is a different thing, and I answer. I come to where he is. For a little while nothing on this floor can kill him, because I have said so. And there is Orthrus. Good boy. We are leaving.

beats.headline: The plane, and the grenade
beats.text: An aircraft, crashing. Crawler Carl in it, beaten; Crawler Quan Ch about to finish him. Then Carl does two things nobody had on the board: he takes Emberus as his god, mid-fall, and he throws a celestial grenade. The god comes to him. This file only needs to note that Quan Ch had it won, and then he did not.

beats.headline: Maggie My, cut out at last
beats.text: Maggie My is dead. Carl went through Chris Andrews to reach her, cut her out of him, and she went for Carl anyway, because of course she did. Mongo finished her. So that is both of them, Frank and Maggie, the pair who spent the first floor teaching this planet that the word safe on a door is decoration. I put the word there. I'd like that on the record too.

beats.headline: Waiting on the last stage
beats.text: Carl and Donut and me, sitting on our hands while Katia goes to the water quadrant. The last part of the plan is Carl's, and Carl does not say what the last part is until it is already happening. I like plans like that. I like the part where things happen. Louis is somewhere else, and I would like it on the record that I would rather he was here. There. It is on the record.

beats.headline: Her mother comes when called
beats.text: Slit. A feral demon, and it is hunting ME, like I do not have enough going on. So they open the safe room and roll me out to deal with it, which is apparently a plan: one head versus one demon. Fine. I call for Mother. Mother comes when I call. Mother kills Slit, and everyone here is now looking at me the way they should have been looking at me from the start.

beats.headline: Agent Provocateur
beats.text: The Hunting Grounds are opening and I take the bomb-focused specialisation. Agent Provocateur. I would like to be very, very good at exactly one thing, and I have picked the thing.

beats.headline: Agent Provocateur
beats.text: The bomb-focused specialisation, taken on the Hunting Grounds.

beats.headline: He named her Tsarina
beats.text: Background, for the file. Grimaldi pulled a half-Naiad child out of the hands of the High Elves and raised her in his circus. The child grew up. The child fell in love with him. She told him once that had she been full-blooded Naiad she would have been a tsarina, so he made it her name, and Tsarina Signet is what she has answered to since. Ringmasters name things. It is most of the job.

beats.headline: The Daughters come apart
beats.text: The Hunting Grounds. We are not the party we were on the third floor, and I am not going to pretend otherwise. What I decided back there, about who I kept and who I handed off, has followed me down here. It has followed Katia. It has followed Eva. I saw it coming and I made the call anyway. That is what leading is. Ask me on another day whether it was the right one.

beats.headline: Signet has a writers' room
beats.text: Vengeance of the Daughter is a scripted programme with producers steering her grief and her revenge for the audience. She is not something the dungeon generated. She is someone it is being done to.

beats.headline: Borant would like the Gate back
beats.text: The Hunting Grounds. I have been sent to Crawler Carl with a request from Borant, which I am instructed to describe as a request. They would like the Gate of the Feral Gods surrendered, voluntarily, to be held until the ninth floor and not a floor longer. I put it to him exactly as written. He asked for a lawyer. I have passed that back exactly as spoken. I expect to be sent again.

beats.headline: Tish's note
beats.text: According to a note left by his associate Tish, the Gate of the Feral Gods was considered essential to defeating Scolopendra, whose poison has already done its work on the Hunting Grounds.

beats.headline: Daughter of King Finian, and of nobody
beats.text: I am the daughter of King Finian of the High Elves of the Liana Sector, and of a Naiad princess. She was murdered, and the Confederacy took her crown. Both halves of my family then agreed on one thing, which was that I should not exist among them. I was a child. Grimaldi's circus took me in when no throne would. That is the whole of my inheritance: a name, an exile, and a tent.

beats.headline: Blood magic, cast on a loser
beats.text: The tattoos move under my skin because they are not pictures. They are Blood and Ink Elementals, and I raise them. The craft is exact. I set two creatures against each other and I cast on the one I judge will lose, before it has taken a single wound. I may not bleed the sacrifice myself; that is the law of it. Only the killing blow, struck by another hand, releases what I need. One summoning a night. Judge badly and the night is wasted.

beats.headline: Her loyalty does not extend to crawlers
beats.text: I will say it plainly, since the crawlers already know. I tried to make Carl my blood sacrifice, and not with his consent. I put Donut under the Water Lily Spell. I made him bring me to the cursed circus when he had other places to be. I do not regret one piece of it. Everything I have is owed to the family that took me in when no other would, and a crawler is not family.

beats.headline: Part of the price of the Gate
beats.text: Contract amendment, filed by Quasar, Carl's new lawyer. Carl surrenders the Gate, on a temporary basis. In exchange: four mercenaries, free of charge. Bomo. The Sledge. Clay-ton. Very Sullen. Plus two spells, issued to Bomo and the Sledge, that copy two of the Gate's tricks: a jump to the stairwell, and Zerzura. So the client keeps the tricks, loses the object, and gets four bodies thrown in. Lawyers, crawler. Get one.

beats.headline: The deal for the Gate
beats.text: I arrive, I introduce myself as my client's counsel, and we proceed to terms. The Gate goes back. Temporarily. In consideration: four mercenaries at no charge to my client, Bomo, the Sledge, Clay-ton and Very Sullen, and two spells for Bomo and the Sledge that reproduce two of the Gate's abilities, teleport to stairwell and zerzura. My client wanted to keep it. Everyone wants to keep it. A negotiation is what you get instead.

beats.headline: He moves them to the stairwell
beats.text: Service rendered. The hunters are about to be released and the clients want to be somewhere else, specifically the stairwell in Zockau. Bomo casts the spell he was issued, and Carl and Princess Donut are there. No fuss, no speech, no ceremony. Some mercenaries want to be thanked; this one has already been paid for, in Gate. Enjoy Zockau, crawler.

beats.headline: Zockau burns
beats.text: Zockau burns. I mark hunters with the Ring of Divine Suffering, I kill them, and I take their stats, and enough of them are inside the Desperado Club when it goes that the survivors have to be dug out. I get hurt on the way out. That part is fair.

beats.headline: Full of hunters when the roof comes in
beats.text: Carl's explosives bring Zockau down and trap a great many of them inside it.

beats.headline: Zockau
