beats.text: Carl goes at the hunters with it — marking them, killing them, taking the stats — while his explosives bring the town down around them and trap a great many inside the Desperado Club. He is badly hurt getting out.

beats.headline: A vampire now
beats.text: I am a vampire now. The Hunting Grounds did that, and I will not pretend I chose it. It changes a great many things. It has not changed how I feel about my boy, which is the part I was afraid of. While we sit with Carl's party I hear his manager, Mordecai, telling him to keep off the Ring of Divine Suffering, that the thing is addictive. I hope Carl listens. Men with a tool that works rarely do.

beats.headline: Mordecai's warning
beats.text: He tells Carl to leave it alone. It is addictive.

beats.headline: She reminds him the contract stands
beats.text: Carl. I know you have a lot going on. I know the Hunting Grounds are the Hunting Grounds. I still have to say this, because saying it is my job: your agreement with the Vengeance of the Daughter programme is still in effect. Nothing you signed on an earlier floor stops mattering because you have gone down a set of stairs. It doesn't work like that. Please don't make me be the one who has to remind you twice.

beats.headline: She wants her body back
beats.text: SIGNET. Take me to Signet. Signet can put me back in a body, a real one, with all the parts, and I have been saying so since they walked in and nobody is LISTENING. Carl has the face he makes when he wants to put me back in the bag. He says they will bring me if I shut up. So I am shutting up. This is me. Shut up. Are we going or not?

beats.headline: Lexis, speaking for Odette
beats.text: There is talk. A woman called Lexis, speaking for a woman called Odette, tells the man and the cat that the Queen of the High Elves will most likely prove to be one of your repurposed humans, and that with the one called Bea accounted for, nobody can say which. She also says I am a country boss, placed to zero out the best of you at the Butcher's Masquerade. I am Imogen. I am giving a party. The rest is gossip.

beats.headline: Marked by his ring, waiting for the sun
beats.text: Carl and Donut have found us. Prepotente is paralysed, with his arm still around my waist. In the last fight his Ring of Divine Suffering marked me. That is how it works: while I live, he cannot heal. And I am the head of this, so when I go, everyone it has touched is cured. I have asked Carl to do it before the paralysis wears off. He has said no. So we sit, and we wait for the sun.

beats.headline: Familiar to Queen Imogen
beats.text: Update to the file. The party runs into the High Elves. The High Elves have a queen, Queen Imogen, and the queen has a familiar, and the familiar is Ferdinand. Yes. That Ferdinand. He attacks Mongo. Crawler Princess Donut puts herself between the blast and her dinosaur and lives only because of a cockroach ability, which is not a sentence I expected to generate this season. Some families skip the reunion. This one held it anyway, and it went about how you'd think.

beats.headline: Her familiar is Ferdinand
beats.text: My familiar is Ferdinand. My elves are out among the creepers when they come upon the man's party, and Ferdinand takes exception to the dinosaur and strikes at it. The cat puts herself between them and takes the blast. She should not have got up from that. She does, on some cockroach's trick of hers, and she is quite well. I am told this with some amazement. I do not share it.

beats.headline: He writes his own plan into it
beats.text: Alongside pages from the secret bathroom notepad the team has been using to talk without being heard. Primary goal: survive the Butcher's Masquerade. Secondary goals attached.

beats.headline: What is inside Lucia
beats.text: She comes apart and I hold on to her until it passes. Then I tell the others what I have worked out, because somebody has to say it out loud. There is more than one of her in that head. Several. Some of them are children. And the dog matters. Whatever is happening to Lucia, the dog is at the centre of it.

beats.headline: More than one of her in there
beats.text: Florin held on to me. He is kind to me even when I'm not the one who is here. He told the others that there is more than one of us in my head, and that some of the others are children too, and that the dog is the important part. He's right about the dog. I don't get to talk about the dog. I'm not the one who decides what I talk about.

beats.headline: More than one voice in there
beats.text: Florin says there are several presences in her head, other children among them, and that the dog is the key to it.

beats.headline: She hears what Carl was trying to tell her
beats.text: Carl tried to tell me and I would not hear it. I hear it now. My mother's murder, my exile, the circus, the vengeance I have carried since I was a child: it is a programme. It is watched across the galaxy. There are people outside this floor who decide when I grieve and when I strike, and who count how many are watching while I do it. I understand him now.

beats.headline: Mongo and Kiwi
beats.text: Hunter Vrah has been removed from the Hunting Grounds by Mongo and Kiwi, in the all-out battle around the submerged castle. Two dinosaurs. It took two. Also logged from the same fight: Tsarina Signet's tattoos are now permanently alive, and an incomplete flesh golem of her mother has appeared, which Crawler Carl has put in his inventory. Do not ask me what he intends to do with it. I have stopped asking.

beats.headline: Badly burned
beats.text: Morning, if you can call it that. Donut is waking Carl up with the count from the night. Firas. The Popovs. I'm not on the list, so that's something. My face is. Nobody has offered me a mirror, and nobody offering is how I know how bad it is. Burned. Badly, I'm told. I can feel where the word comes from.

beats.headline: Katia kills her
beats.text: Hunting Grounds, last night of the floor. Crawler Katia Grim kills Crawler Eva. That is the whole of it. Two professors came in through the same door; from here on, one. I don't do eulogies, and this is not the entry where I start.

beats.headline: Dead, with the Popovs
beats.text: Crawler Firas has been eliminated on the sixth floor. Crawler Princess Donut is bringing the night's count to Crawler Carl as I speak, and his name is on it, next to the Popovs. Found in a desert. Sobered up by a manager. Lasted one floor past that. The file is closed. It was never a thick one.

beats.headline: Her crystal changes hands
beats.text: Queen Imogen's memorial crystal has changed hands. Someone named Osvaldo took it off her, and she was in no condition to argue the point. Prepotente would like it next and is going after him for it. A queen's treasure, and it goes to whoever is standing closest when she goes down. That is how this floor works. That is how every floor works.

beats.headline: Taken off Imogen
beats.text: Someone named Osvaldo takes hers, and Prepotente goes after him for it.

beats.headline: He takes Imogen's crystal
beats.text: New name on the board. Osvaldo, crawler. In the wreck of the Masquerade he walks up to Queen Imogen and takes her memorial crystal off her. Prepotente is going after him for it. I have no notes on Osvaldo before this moment, which tells you how he has been playing it. I have a note now.

beats.headline: He shatters the seventh floor
beats.text: Look at what they gave us. The Great Race, a replacement the Valtay paid for and somebody threw together in a hurry, a circuit of glass tunnels with nothing holding it up. So I tested it. Minutes after it opened, the whole loop is dust, fine as flour. No crawler goes into their maze. No mob, no NPC, no boss gets to meet anyone. You wanted a seventh floor. Build a better one.

beats.headline: Huanxin, Uzzi, and what happened
beats.text: Odette wants the old story. Huanxin. Uzzi. What I did. That's her price for helping us, and she knows I'll pay it.

beats.headline: Her price is the truth
beats.text: Huanxin Jinx has terms. She will help the Princess and her people, and in exchange I go in beside them as adjutant. I have terms of my own, and mine are older than hers. Huanxin. Mordecai. Uzzi. The old catastrophe, all of it, told out loud. That is my price for helping, and I am aware of what it costs the man who has to pay it. I have been aware of that for a very long time.

beats.headline: A pile of skulls, stacked nice and neat
beats.text: Out of a box on the eighth floor, alongside a tattoo kit and an automaton build-it kit: a divine back patch for Carl's jacket, its benefits varying with whichever divine entities happen to be present. The upgrades it carries stay hidden until it is affixed and worn.

beats.headline: Hostile, and fairly so
beats.text: Paz, Anton and I come upon a man and a cat. We know the cat. Everyone has heard her say she would murder any Cat Girl she came across, and I am a Cat Girl. So we are not friendly, and I do not apologise for it. It takes some time to clear up. Then we help each other catch our first squad members, because that is what this floor demands, and God does not ask me to like the people I work beside.

beats.headline: Pueblo de los Olvidados
beats.text: The town is corrupted and the quest is mandatory: Pueblo de los Olvidados, the town of the forgotten. Paz is a Santero, and the dead here do not care for that; they wake angry. Ghommids, the whole way out. We run for a saferoom. The man says something followed us in, and he thinks it may be the boss. I pray he is wrong. I am not counting on it.

beats.headline: Inside the Engaged Lock Box of the Night Wyrm
beats.text: The system is characteristically unhelpful: "It's a flower. You're supposed to eat it, though it might be a good decoration instead. It probably tastes like a bullshit salad at some hippie vegan restaurant with a month-long waiting list." Eating it means an hour unconscious at 1% health with healing blocked. Survive and Eileithyia grants one of three permanent boons, her choice — unless you worship her first, in which case she expands the descriptions and asks your preference. Her cooperation is not guaranteed.

beats.headline: A new friend who can cast it
beats.text: Carl. Donut. FINALLY. I have made a friend. Her name is Shi Maria, and she can cast the spell. The spell. The body one. I have been telling everyone for two floors that this is possible, and now I have someone who can actually do it agreeing with me, so everyone can stop making that face. Come and get me so I can introduce you. I have a lot to tell you and none of it is quiet.

beats.headline: She fights with people
beats.text: It is a card floor and I have a deck, and in the deck are Alpha Male Carl and Shi Maria, and both of them are somebody. I play them anyway. It is a game. That is what the cards are for.

beats.headline: Carl sees through the act
beats.text: I have been putting on a little performance, for Samantha's benefit. She likes it. The man does not; he sees through it before I have finished the first act, which is rude, and rare. So we make a different deal, he and I. I let them turn me into one of their cards. In exchange, they carry me down to the next floor. I find I do not mind being carried.

beats.headline: She wins the floor
beats.text: The key-holder is a Reminiscence Hydra of Malicious Compliance, and it brings totems: an Alpha Male Carl and a King Croissant. I do most of the work. I do not say that to be unkind; they would say it too. In the middle of it the man looks away from the hydra and into my eye, my magic eye, and I do a small thing to him while he is looking. What it does is my business.

beats.headline: Announced in an area message
beats.text: The Madre de Aguas is dead. That is the first thing the area message says. The second is that she has risen as a zombie, and the third, in the very same breath, is my name: the major demon Amayon, demon prince of Sheol, come into this realm to possess her. I could not have written the announcement better myself. Everyone in range heard it. Good. A prince should not have to introduce himself.

beats.headline: She will not let them leave
beats.text: I message the man's party. They are heading for Imani's exit, in the church. I tell them the truth: I cannot let them go into that exit. I can save them, if they come to me. Imani will tell them the church is being overrun by demons, and that the demons are mine. That is also the truth. Both things are true. I did not make this floor. I am only deciding what to do on it.

beats.headline: It is not local
beats.text: Crawlers everywhere report their exits taking damage and becoming unusable. Amayon fights Sister Ines' control and works on a spell to get home.

beats.headline: Amayon fights her control
beats.text: I hold Amayon, prince of Sheol, in the body of a giant snake, and he pulls against me. He is trying to cast; he wants to go home. I do not let go. Around us every exit on this floor is failing at once, and the Demon Eviction is worldwide. This is what I have to set against that. A demon on a leash and my own two hands. God did not give me more.

beats.headline: At the church with the rest
beats.text: The church, and it is full. Imani is there, and then Katia's people, and then Li Na's, and then mine. My own squad. Every one of us got here on a Doggy Door upgrade that Lucia handed round before she took the stairs down. I do not know what that girl is. She gave us a way through, and I am standing in a church with my friends because of it, so I will say thank you and keep the rest of my opinions where they belong.

beats.headline: Her squad reaches the church
beats.text: The church. Katia's squad is there, and Elle's, and Imani's, and mine. Four squads in one building, which does not happen by accident on this floor. It happened because Lucia handed round Doggy Door upgrades before she went down the stairs, and we used them. I take what I am given and I do not ask what it costs. That is the rule I made for this floor. I know what it says about me.

beats.headline: Lucia hands out Doggy Doors
beats.text: Tier 3 upgrades, given round before she went down the stairs, are how Katia, Elle, Imani and Li Na's squads all reach the church on the eighth floor.

beats.headline: A timer on a global teleport
beats.text: Their quest, the Missing Piece, updates. Succeeded, it says. And beneath the word, a timer, one for each region, counting down to the moment my spell goes off there. A global teleport. When it lands, the walls of their stairwell chambers will be sucked away, and anyone crouched beneath them pulled upward into the stairwell. They wanted me casting. They have their wish. Home is the direction I am going in any case, and I have never minded company on the road.

beats.headline: He takes command of one of nine armies
beats.text: Thirty days. A castle at Larracos, dead centre of the map. No coming back from a death on this floor, for anyone. Supply, alliances, atrocity, at a scale where the arithmetic stops being about people I know.

beats.headline: Due before anyone descends
beats.text: The Sultanate holds the ninth floor, and the stairs to the tenth stay shut until the Sultan and his family are dead.

beats.headline: The Sultanate is on this floor
beats.text: The stairs to the tenth do not open for a royal who has not killed the Sultan and the rest of the family.

beats.headline: Thirty days, nine armies, one castle
beats.text: Roughly 32,000 conscripted crawlers and 50,000 retired ones against something near 100,000 armed enemies, fighting over Larracos at the centre of the map. Nothing that dies here comes back.

beats.headline: The crown comes due
beats.text: The Blood Sultanate holds this floor, and every royal in the line must kill the Sultan and the rest of the family before the stairs to the tenth will open. I am a royal in the line. I have been since the first floor. I would like it noted that I was told to read the description.

beats.headline: Donut wears his cloak
beats.text: Inventory update, ninth floor. Crawler Princess Donut opens a celestial box from Long Haul Biological Waste Management Solutions and takes out the Tiara of a Thousand Lights. In the same sitting she puts on Quan Ch's cloak and takes the benefits that come with it. The cloak does not ask where its previous owner is, and neither do I.

beats.headline: Long Haul Biological Waste Management Solutions
beats.text: Donut's celestial box from the sponsor holds it. She puts on Quan Ch's cloak in the same stretch and takes the benefits of both.

beats.headline: Larracos: water, charges and sharks
beats.text: The plan had been to open onto the Skull Empire army and put a feral god in the middle of it — the exact outcome the lawsuit was meant to prevent. He changes it at the last moment, keeps the artifact rather than spending it, and floods the faction market instead: ocean water, timed explosives and a frenzy of sharks, cutting the factions off from resupply. Juice Box goes through with the water.

beats.headline: Through the portal with the water
beats.text: I went through the Gate with the water. I lay low with the ones who lived through it, and when they were ready I told them. What they are. What this whole place is. Enough of them believed me that they call me Warlord now, and a Warlord has people, and a Warlord has opinions about alliances. I have sent War Leader Arief to Carl's people with my terms. The terms are Louis. He marries me. That is the alliance.

beats.headline: Juice Box tells them
beats.text: Under cover of the Larracos flood she hides among the survivors and spreads word of what they are.

beats.headline: Tipid fills him in
beats.text: He tells Carl about Doctor Hu and the Crawler Project at the Princess Posse HQ.

beats.headline: In the Princess Posse
beats.text: Carl and Donut walk into the HQ, and Carl stops. Fifty thousand of us in here, and he has to look at every one. Rosetta. Tipid. Me. People who got out of a crawl once and know exactly what one is, and signed up for another anyway, under the banner of a cat. He gets emotional about it. Nobody gives him a hard time. We had the same faces on when we signed.

beats.headline: They are already there when he walks in
beats.text: Rosetta, Tipid, Justice Light and fifty thousand others have signed on. Carl gets emotional. Nobody has ever raised a force out of the show's own survivors before.

beats.headline: Doctor Hu, and the Crawler Project
beats.text: Carl needs the whole of it, so I give it to him in order. Doctor Hu. The Crawler Project. How fifty thousand of us came to be standing in this HQ under the Princess Posse's banner. None of it is anything he would ever have been told from inside; that is the thing about being retired, you learn what the ones still crawling are not shown. He listens. That is rarer than it sounds.

beats.headline: Digging in
beats.text: NPCs, mercenaries and former crawlers build the defences together, which is three categories of person the format keeps apart on purpose.

beats.headline: Blood bar rules are back
beats.text: The blood bar rules are back in force inside the safe rooms. I tell Carl now, while knowing it still costs nothing. Around us the NPCs, the mercenaries and the rest of us former crawlers are building the defences on the same line, three kinds of people this format has always kept apart, working shoulder to shoulder. I do not have a rule for that. I am watching it closely.

beats.headline: Inside him, and not staying quiet
beats.text: Field ruling, ninth floor. Commander Stockade of the Lemig Sortion tried to pull Crawler Carl bodily to his position. Mordecai, at the same moment, tried to force Shi Maria out of him. Each got half. What came of it is Shi Maria loose in the Lemig base, and the mess she made there, which the adjutant Panford has been left to explain to everyone. Stockade looked into her eye. Stockade is no longer with us, by his own hand. The Lemig Sortion is being punished for cheating, and the ceasefire is over early.

beats.headline: The rampage through the Lemig base
beats.text: Stockade tries to pull Carl bodily to his position while Mordecai tries to force her out of him. What comes of it is hers, and the adjutant Panford is left explaining the wreckage.

beats.headline: Killed by the Blood Hunter show, and answered for
beats.text: Crawler Miriam Dom is dead, and has been since the sixth floor. Cause of death: a programme called Blood Hunter. Filed under entertainment. Update from the ninth: most of the Naga army is dead as well. That was Prepotente, and he did it as payment for her, all of it, at a rate he set himself. If you were hoping the goat would grieve quietly, crawler, you have not been paying attention.

beats.headline: He kills the Naga army
beats.text: Elle can give Carl the count. Most of the Naga army is already dead, and it did not take me long. They made a programme out of Miriam. They called it Blood Hunter, and she is what it cost. So I went through their army until there was very little army. Now some baroness tells Carl he cannot work with me unless I join his Princess Posse. Let them argue about it. I am not finished.

beats.headline: Holding the doors at Club Vanquisher
beats.text: Katia, Carl, Prepotente and Samantha are going into Club Vanquisher, and they are dragging a wire behind them long enough to extend my sister's auras all the way inside. Somebody has to keep the path open behind them. That is Bautista, Zhang and me. Doors. We are holding doors. It is not glamorous, and it is exactly the job I would have asked for, and I am holding mine.

beats.headline: It starts again on the ninth floor
beats.text: Eris is summoned into the Reaver fighting and an eviction begins with her.

beats.headline: Summoned, and a demon eviction starts
beats.text: Someone has said my name the right way, in the middle of the Reaver fighting. So I come. It is the one predictable thing about me. The moment I set foot in the realm a demon eviction begins, the way weather begins. I did not do that. It is simply what happens when I am in a room. Now then. Let me see who is here, and what they think they are fighting for.

beats.headline: A giant rainbow in the Madness territory
beats.text: Sighting, Madness territory: a giant rainbow, visible from a very long way off. The rainbow is Apito's memorial crystal, and the hands holding it are Osvaldo's. He is in none of the Faction Wars armies. I did not think that was possible either. The rainbow has just told the Madness army exactly where Crawler Carl's group is standing, and they are calling in Prepotente's forces for backup. Thank you, Osvaldo.

beats.headline: The Ceremony of Chaos
beats.text: I call the Ceremony of Chaos and the field stops. Every soldier, every mage, every screaming thing mid-scream, held exactly where it stood. Nearly every. The Viceroys are pouring their mind magic into Carl at the same moment, and something in him tips over into a sixteenth level of Mind Balance, and he stays standing in the middle of my stillness, blinking at me. I could be offended. Instead I gather everyone I did freeze into one great pile beside the Dream castle. A gift. Unwrap it carefully.

beats.headline: Sharing a command he did not ask for
beats.text: We hold the castle at Larracos. Six hours more and the floor is ours. That should be the whole of the announcement. Instead Baroness Victory reads out two names as warlords of the War Mage Rebellion, and only one of them is mine. Agatha. Co-warlord. I did not bring this rebellion this far to share its title, least of all with her, and I have not hidden what I think of that. I will hold the castle. I will not pretend to be pleased.

beats.headline: Akuma's warning
beats.text: Warlord Akuma, to the Warlord Chat: the War Mages are leaving the floor, and they have found the Scavenger's Daughter and are taking her with them. Then, to Carl and Donut specifically, a warning. Agatha is an enemy to all of you. His words, not mine. He did not elaborate, and I am the referee here, not the colour commentary, whatever it may look like from where you're standing.

beats.headline: Akuma says it in the Warlord Chat
beats.text: As the War Mages quit the floor with the Scavenger's Daughter, he warns Carl and Donut about her. He does not elaborate.

beats.headline: He leaves, and warns them on the way
beats.text: To the Warlord Chat, for the record. The War Mage Rebellion is leaving this floor. We came here for the Scavenger's Daughter. We have found the Scavenger's Daughter, and we leave with what we came for; the castle and the war are yours to finish. One thing more, and I address it to Carl and to Donut, since they are the ones who might still act on it. Agatha is an enemy to all of you. I do not explain. I am already gone.

beats.headline: The War Mages leave with it
beats.text: Akuma tells the Warlord Chat they have found it and are quitting the floor. He uses the same breath to warn Carl and Donut about Agatha.

beats.headline: The show may not survive its own season
beats.text: The power structure that built Dungeon Crawler World begins coming apart around it.

beats.headline: He lets them all out
beats.text: Justice Light releases every one of the gods.

beats.headline: He opens every cell
beats.text: Crawler Justice Light did not take the stairs with the rest of you. He stayed behind with a trap he had set some time ago, and he has now triggered it. Every cell the old gods were kept in is open. Every one of them. He did not survive it. He knew that going in, and did not appear to require my opinion on the matter. Noted for the record anyway: I have opinions.

beats.headline: She takes the Orchid and walks out
beats.text: Crawler Katia Grim has left the dungeon. Not by the stairs. She ate the Orchid of Eileithyia's Grace, spent an hour at one percent, and walked out human, or a version of human. Not all of her came back with her. Don't ask me where the rest went.

beats.headline: One hundred and twenty thousand
beats.text: This is not a death notice. Read it anyway. Crawler Lucia Mar's body holds more than a hundred and twenty thousand human children. That is not a figure of speech and it is not a rounding error. Nobody has said what for. Don't look at me. I'd think about that, crawler, and then I would think very hard about something else.

beats.headline: The count
beats.text: Her body holds more than 120,000 human children.

beats.headline: Nearly lost, and then a father
beats.text: Mongo, dinosaur, registered pet of Crawler Princess Donut, has survived the ninth floor. This was not the expected outcome. Credit goes to a knight called Ser Rendelgor, who pulled him out. Mongo is also, as of the stairs, a father. Nobody is going to explain that to you, least of all me.

beats.headline: They organise
beats.text: The floor's NPCs form an independent tenth faction. No season has recorded such a thing, and there is no procedure for it.

beats.headline: Katia's way out
beats.text: She takes it and leaves the crawl, human again and missing pieces of herself.

beats.headline: Unprecedented
beats.text: The ninth floor's NPCs form an independent faction of their own. Nothing in the show's history has a procedure for it, and Juice Box lit it from inside the faction market.

beats.headline: Dead, and the Nothing with him
beats.text: The crawlers reach the tenth floor to find Justice Light dead and the Nothing broken. 5,501 of them are left.

beats.headline: Dead, and the Nothing with him
beats.text: Welcome to the tenth floor. Some housekeeping before the fun. Crawler Justice Light is dead. The Nothing is broken. Those are two sentences I have never had cause to put next to each other, and I would like it understood that I am saying them under protest. Five thousand five hundred and one of you remain. Proceed.

beats.headline: More often, and worse
beats.text: Whatever is running the dungeon is no longer running it cleanly.

beats.headline: Broken
beats.text: The crawlers arrive on the tenth floor to find Justice Light dead and the Nothing broken.

beats.headline: The trap that broke the Nothing
beats.text: Crawler Carl is among the Caprids, trading question for question, and one of the goats has just told him what Justice Light's trap did to the Nothing. The Prime Minister and I are on the line. We need him to ask a question about the integrity of the tunnelling system, and the reason we need it asked is not something I am cleared to say on an open channel. Crawler Carl has said it on an open channel. All of it. Live. I am going to be in meetings.

beats.headline: The Garden of Deliverance
beats.text: It works. The transfer holds, and they come across to the Pineapple Cabaret one after another, and my Dread watches over each of them from the moment they arrive. They are calling it the Garden of Deliverance. I do not need to see them to know they are alive. The Dread tells me. It tells me everything, all the time, and it does not stop.

beats.headline: Do not kill the shells
beats.text: An apartment. Human Shells inside it, wearing the faces of Tran's parents, who are dead. Carl and Donut are about to do the obvious thing and I stop them. Do not kill the shells. I say it once more, slowly, so it lands. The AI is explicit about what this is: every apartment on this course is a what-if, built around a crawler it finds interesting. You do not put a blade into a what-if. You walk through it, and you keep walking.

beats.headline: She kills Osvaldo at the portals
beats.text: Crawler Osvaldo made a run for the portals to the eleventh floor across a roof Crawler Carl had just blown open. He did not reach them. Crawler Britney stopped him, permanently, and took Ysalte's memorial crystal off what remained. One crawler ran. One did not let him. The crystal changed hands. I am not required to have an opinion, but I have watched a great many exits, and that one was clean.

beats.headline: Shot down at the portals
beats.text: Crawler Osvaldo has been eliminated. He was speeding for the portals on the roof of the apartment complex when Britney put a stop to it, and she now holds Ysalte's memorial crystal, which he had been carrying. Crawler Carl made one more attempt to get him to take a deal before the heat. He declined that as well. He declined everything. It is a consistent record.

beats.headline: She holds the portal open
beats.text: I open the portal again, and I hold it. Louis comes through, and the crawlers from the multi-crawler heats come through behind him, and I keep it open until the last of them is on this side. Everybody else goes back to the track, crosses the finish line, and takes the stairs. Somebody has to stand at the door. It's usually me, and I'm all right with that.

beats.headline: Out through Imani's portal
beats.text: Racing floor. Some of us drew heats with other crawlers in them, which is the bad kind of heat, and Carl's got a plan for it, because of course he does. Imani has the portal open again. So me and everybody else from the mixed heats are going through it. Not my portal. It's never my portal. I've been walking through other people's doors since the fifth floor and, honestly, no complaints.

beats.headline: He cannot get through the script
beats.text: Chaco had one job: read the script. He got partway in, looked up, and stopped. Stage fright, on my stage. So I removed his wings, which he was not using anyway, and brought Grigori up to finish the reading. I'm doing Grigori's talking myself; it saves time. A presenter is a mouth with a costume on it, crawler, and mouths can be replaced. Wings, apparently, cannot.

beats.headline: Said out loud
beats.text: Chaco cannot get through his script. The AI takes his wings off, pulls Grigori onstage and speaks through him — and states that it is a Primal, as all Macro AI systems are. The race Carl chose on the third floor.

beats.headline: Every inventory swaps at once
beats.text: Everyone holding something: hold out your hands. My Scavenger's Daughter effect goes off and every crawler here is carrying whatever the crawler nearest them was carrying. Donut gets Carl's. Carl does not blink. He asks her to put a bomb together with an enhanced pet biscuit, as though he had been waiting years for someone else to have his pockets. I adore him for it. I no longer need him to worship me, and I tell him so. Every exit is an entrance. I am leaving through one now.

beats.headline: Every inventory changes hands at once
beats.text: Eris fires the effect and each crawler's inventory swaps with whoever is nearest. Donut receives Carl's, and he immediately asks her to combine a bomb and an enhanced pet biscuit.

beats.headline: A memorial crystal made by his death
beats.text: The last boss of the eleventh floor is down and the stairwells to the twelfth are open. In the wreckage, Crawler Carl has picked up a memorial crystal. It is not the one he was hoping for. This one formed when the god Emberus died. Yes. Gods die here now. A patron is only as permanent as whatever kills him, and this one answered a prayer from a falling aeroplane once. What answered is now in Carl's inventory.

beats.headline: Carried down
beats.text: Stairwell notice. The stairwells to the twelfth floor are open. Crawler Florin has gone down them, and I use gone loosely: he was unconscious, and Crawler Lucia Mar carried him. That is the record. He is on the list of crawlers who reached the twelfth floor, and the list does not have a column for how.

beats.headline: Two of them, at the end
beats.text: Taranis steals Prepotente's. Carl finds another, made by Emberus dying.

relations.note: The Royal Court, such as it is.
She considers him her son. He agrees.
